pages.title: Changing Matter
pages.text: The old dream, and it works. I show the chamber what I want, a compound set as its $(thing)target$(). Only an image, never used. Whatever compounds I feed it become that target.
A book that reads itself. Its catalyst turns the pages. I never learned their language, only that matter listens.

pages.name: Transmutation Chamber
pages.text: A library around the book, built in front of it.

pages.title: The Library
pages.text: Stone bricks, spruce and oak logs, shelves of both woods facing the front, a redstone lamp and lanterns.$(br2)The book faces whoever placed it, and the library must stand before it.

pages.title: Its Price
pages.text: Value is kept, but a fifth of it is lost when the two are worth different amounts. Whatever is left over waits for the next change.$(br2)Each change takes two seconds and 5 DE for every Abundant compound of value made.

pages.title: Its Rules
pages.text: It only works within a family. Minerals become minerals, essences become essences.$(br2)Netherite weighs as much as five diamonds, so the two trade freely. Like every core, it starves without a $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$() above it.
